ops-bot: CAP template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/infra/cap-templates. Reminder: include rollback criteria and SLOs in playbook (p95, fallback%, error%).

anya: Jules/Marco/Tessa paste links when ready. I'm creating REM-3990 and a 30m post-drill validation. We'll reconvene after the soak to close items. :thumbsup:
